name: Zotero TaskFlow
shortDescription: 将文献研读转化为可追踪的任务与计划。
Turn literature reading into trackable tasks and plans.
introduction: 面向需要安排阅读、写作和研究工作的用户，把待办、截止日期、子任务和研读进度关联到 Zotero 文献与 PDF 位置。
For researchers planning reading, writing, and project work: link tasks, deadlines, subtasks, and reading progress to Zotero papers and PDF locations.
githubDescription: Turn literature reading into trackable tasks and plans. Part of Zotero Flow.
